title: One fact of a wagon's train state (wagons.jsonl)
description: A fact about a wagon of the standing train (hal2 plan 0604 step 7, D11; scripts/wagon_store.py), append-only: the status (entering, ready, boarded, hitched) is never stored, wagons.py computes it from these facts and git. `slot` is the wagon's field (`14`, `farmer-hal2`, `yard`); lines written before plan 0604 have `field` instead and are rewritten once by `wagon_store.py migrate`.

at.description: RFC 3339 UTC with Z and whole seconds.

by.description: Who wrote it: `ingest` (read from log.jsonl or train.jsonl) or `tollman` (by hand).

id.description: An order's id (the ack id of the message); an answer or a close names the order it is for; a need from train.jsonl carries the train line's id when it has one.

sha.description: An answer (done): the commit it named; a need: the commit that must reach the carrier.

why.description: A need or close: the reason.
